pre_registered_gates.name: Net Cumulative P&L > £0
pre_registered_gates.description: Total net realised P&L after all Trading212 frictions must be positive.

pre_registered_gates.name: Profit Factor >= 1.30
pre_registered_gates.description: Gross profits divided by gross losses must be >= 1.30.

pre_registered_gates.name: Expectancy Per Trade > £0
pre_registered_gates.description: Net dollar expectancy per closed execution must be > £0.00.

pre_registered_gates.name: 1.5x Cost-Stress Expectancy > £0
pre_registered_gates.description: Expectancy with 50% adverse spread and slippage penalty must remain positive.

pre_registered_gates.name: 2.0x Cost-Stress Survival
pre_registered_gates.description: Double friction stress must not produce economic catastrophe (Net P&L >= £0).

pre_registered_gates.name: Maximum Equity Drawdown <= 10.0%
pre_registered_gates.description: Peak-to-trough equity drawdown must not breach 10.0%.

pre_registered_gates.name: Independent Causal Audit Zero Violations
pre_registered_gates.description: CausalAuditor must certify 0 lookahead, timing, or negative duration violations.

pre_registered_gates.name: Best Trade Removal Net P&L > £0
pre_registered_gates.description: Cumulative net P&L must remain positive after removing the single largest winner.

pre_registered_gates.name: Asset Diversification (No Asset > 80% P&L)
pre_registered_gates.description: No single ETF ticker may contribute > 80.0% of total cumulative positive P&L.

pre_registered_gates.name: Benchmark Non-Inferiority (Return/Drawdown)
pre_registered_gates.description: Strategy Return-to-Drawdown ratio must match or exceed S&P 500 Buy & Hold.
